cd.title: Polyphonic
cd.situation: DJ K-Bit's bleepy electronic track is 'too weird for 2004', but everyone at this bus stop has a flip phone.

actions.label: beamed DJ K-Bit's track to your phone by infrared
actions.line: K-Bit lines his phone up with yours. 'Hold still... infrared is basically magic.' Beep. Boop. 'Polyphonic' is now your ringtone.

actions.label: let it ring at the busiest bus stop in town
actions.line: Your phone goes off. The whole queue turns round. 'Is that... a ringtone? Where can I GET that?'
actions.lockedLine: You wait at the bus stop. Your phone only knows one ringtone, and it's the boring one. Nobody looks up.

offline.headline: The Bus Queue That Discovered DJ K-Bit
offline.article: In December 2004 a whole bus queue heard DJ K-Bit's 'Polyphonic' ring out of one flip phone and asked where to get it. By New Year it was the most downloaded ringtone in the country, and its gold disc still hangs in Hollow Records.
